_doc: Edit holds (PLAYBOOK §10.4, §12): seconds of picture time after a sentence, matched by its words. Holds over 0.8 s only at act turns and signature beats. The Gemini review (checked 16 NOV 2026) asked for beats after the names and after 'Definitely Stockton'. tail = the outro. No hearing clip yet: when the 23 SEP 2024 hearing ranges are fetched, clips are added here as holds.
